# nxos_dhcp (Data Source)

This data source can read the DHCP relay configuration on NX-OS devices, including relay interfaces and their associated relay server addresses.

### API Documentation

- [dhcpEntity](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/DHCP/dhcp:Entity/)

- [dhcpRelayIf](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/DHCP/dhcp:RelayIf/)

- [dhcpV6SrcIf](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/DHCP/dhcp:V6SrcIf/)

}

## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `dai_interfaces` (Attributes Map) List of Dynamic ARP Inspection interfaces.
  - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dai_interfaces))
- `dai_log_buffer_entries` (Number) DAI Log Buffer Entries.
- `dai_validate_destination` (Boolean) DAI Validate Type: dst-mac.
- `dai_validate_ip` (Boolean) DAI Validate Type: ip.
- `dai_validate_source` (Boolean) DAI Validate Type: src-mac.
- `dai_vlans` (Attributes Map) List of VLANs with Dynamic ARP Inspection enabled (`ip arp inspection vlan`). Requires the `arp-ether` TCAM region.
  - Map key: `vlan_id` - DAI Vlan Number.
  - Key range: `0`-`65535` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dai_vlans))
- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.
- `ip_source_bindings` (Attributes Map) List of static IP source bindings (`ip source binding`).
  - Map key format: `<ip>;<vlan_id>;<mac>;<interface_id>`
  - Key component `ip`: IP Source Biinding Vlan Number.
  - Key component `vlan_id`: IP Source Biinding Vlan Number. Range: `0`-`65535`.
  - Key component `mac`: IP Source Client Hardware Address.
  - Key component `interface_id`: Interface ID Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_source_bindings))
- `ip_source_guard_excluded_vlans` (Attributes Map) List of VLANs excluded from IP Source Guard (`ip dhcp snooping ipsg-excluded vlan`).
  - Map key: `vlan_id` - Vlan Number to be ecluded from IPSG.
  - Key range: `0`-`65535` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_source_guard_excluded_vlans))
- `ip_source_guard_interfaces` (Attributes Map) List of IP Source Guard interfaces (`ip verify source dhcp-snooping-vlan`). Requires the `ipsg` TCAM region.
  - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_source_guard_interfaces))
- `ipv6_relay_information_option_vpn` (Boolean) IPv6 Relay Information Option Vpn Enabled.
- `ipv6_relay_option79` (Boolean) IPv6 Relay Option79 Enabled.
- `ipv6_relay_option_type_cisco` (Boolean) IPv6 Relay Sub-Option Type Cisco Enabled.
- `ipv6_source_interface` (String) Global Source Interface.
- `ipv6_source_interface_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `packet_strict_validation` (Boolean) Pkt Strict Validation.
- `relay_dai` (Boolean) Dynamic ARP Inspection functionality with DHCP Relay is enabled.
- `relay_information_option` (Boolean) Relay Information Option Enabled.
- `relay_information_option_server_id_override` (Number) Relay Information Option Server-id-override-disable Enabled.
- `relay_information_option_trust` (Boolean) Relay Information Option Trust Enabled.
- `relay_information_option_vpn` (Boolean) Relay Information Option Vpn Enabled.
- `relay_information_trust_all` (Boolean) Relay Information Trust All Enabled.
- `relay_interfaces` (Attributes Map) List of DHCP relay interfaces.
  - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--relay_interfaces))
- `relay_sub_option_circuit_id_customized` (Boolean) Relay Sub-Option Circuit-id Customized Enabled.
- `relay_sub_option_circuit_id_format_string` (String) Relay Sub-Option Circuit-id Format String.
- `relay_sub_option_format_non_tlv` (Boolean) Relay Option82 Sub-Option Format Non-TLV Enabled.
- `relay_sub_option_type_cisco` (Boolean) Relay Sub-Option Type Cisco Enabled.
- `relay_v4_over_v6` (Boolean) v4 over v6 relay transport.
- `relay_v6_iapd_route_add` (Boolean) DHCPv6 IAPD route addition.
- `smart_relay_global` (Boolean) Smart Relay Global Enabled.
- `snoop_sub_option_circuit_id_format_string` (String) Snoop Sub-Option Circuit-id Format String.
- `snooping` (Boolean) Snooping Enabled.
- `snooping_information_option` (Boolean) Snooping Information Option Enabled.
- `snooping_interfaces` (Attributes Map) List of DHCP snooping interfaces.
  - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snooping_interfaces))
- `snooping_sub_option_format_non_tlv` (Boolean) Snooping Option82 Sub-Option Format Non-TLV Enabled.
- `snooping_verify_mac_address` (Boolean) Snooping Verify Mac Address Enabled.
- `snooping_vlans` (Attributes Map) List of VLANs with DHCP snooping enabled (`ip dhcp snooping vlan`).
  - Map key: `vlan_id` - Snoop Vlan Number.
  - Key range: `0`-`65535` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snooping_vlans))
- `source_interface` (String) Global Source Interface.
- `v4_relay` (Boolean) DHCPv4 Enabled.
- `v6_relay` (Boolean) DHCPv6 Enabled.
- `v6_smart_relay_global` (Boolean) V6 Smart Relay Global Enabled.

<a id="nestedatt--relay_interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `relay_interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `addresses` (Attributes Map) List of DHCP relay addresses.
  - Map key format: `<vrf>;<address>`
  - Key component `vrf`: vrf in which the dhcp server is present. Valid only when the client is in a different vrf from the server vrf.
  - Key component `address`: IPv4 or IPv6 address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--relay_interfaces--addresses))
- `information_trusted` (Boolean) Information Trusted Enabled.
- `ipv6_addresses` (Attributes Map) List of DHCPv6 relay addresses.
  - Map key format: `<vrf>;<address>;<destination_interface>`
  - Key component `vrf`: VRF. Use `!unspecified` if no VRF is configured.
  - Key component `address`: v6 Address.
  - Key component `destination_interface`: Destination Interface. Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1` or `vlan100`. Use `unspecified` if no destination interface is configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--relay_interfaces--ipv6_addresses))
- `ipv6_source_interface` (String) Source Interface.
- `options` (String) DHCP options.
- `smart_relay` (Boolean) Smart Relay Enabled.
- `source_interface` (String) Source Interface.
- `subnet_broadcast` (Boolean) Subnet Broadcast Enabled.
- `subnet_selection` (String) DHCP relay source subnet.
- `v6_smart_relay` (Boolean) V6 Smart Relay Enabled.
